en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a stone multi‑arch bridge crossing a calm river with ducks in the water. Trees line the riverbank and a paved promenade runs along the right side. In the distance, there is a dome-shaped building and several multi‑storey houses. The caption "Falkenberg, Bron." appears in the lower left, and a photographer/printer credit in Swedish appears in the lower right.
